nodes.name: Backend Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-step Docker image for the FastAPI backend. Uses python:3.12-slim, installs system deps (gcc, libpq-dev), copies backend/requirements.txt and source, then starts uvicorn on port 8000.

nodes.name: Frontend Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker image for the React frontend. Stage 1 uses node:20-alpine to run 'npm run build', Stage 2 copies the dist output into an nginx:alpine image served on port 80.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Project README file (currently empty — no content yet committed).

nodes.name: Docker Compose
nodes.summary: Orchestrates three services: 'backend' (FastAPI on port 8000, depends on db health), 'frontend' (nginx on port 80, depends on backend), and 'db' (postgres:16-alpine on port 5432 with a named volume 'pgdata'). Includes health checks for both backend and db.

nodes.name: Puppeteer Config
nodes.summary: Points Puppeteer / mermaid-cli to the local Windows chrome-headless-shell executable used for headless diagram rendering.

nodes.name: Render Diagrams Script
nodes.summary: PowerShell script that batch-renders 16 Mermaid architecture diagrams (C4, ER, sequence, state, workflow) from docs/diagrams/*.md into SVG and PNG via @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, using puppeteer-config.json for headless Chrome.

nodes.name: Python Requirements
nodes.summary: Pinned Python package list for the FastAPI backend: alembic, fastapi, SQLAlchemy (async), pydantic v2, uvicorn, bcrypt, python-jose, passlib, asyncpg driver (psycopg2-binary), python-dotenv, and related utilities.

nodes.name: Setup Guide
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Windows developer setup guide covering: PostgreSQL installation and database/user creation, .env configuration with DATABASE_URL and JWT secrets, Python dependency installation, Alembic migration setup (async mode), running the backend with uvicorn, and API verification via curl/Swagger UI.
